items.prompt: Capacity 2: PUT A 1, PUT B 2, GET A, PUT C 3, GET B. What GET lines follow?

options.why: GET A refreshes A, so B is the least-recently-used key and is evicted.
A is present when first read, before C is inserted.
A GET of B cannot return C's value.
The A hit makes order B,A; adding C evicts B.

items.explanation: The A hit makes order B,A; adding C evicts B.
